article.story: FAYETTEVILLE, Ark. -- — Jeremiah Wilkinson scored 28 points and Billy Richmond III added 18 as No. 20 Arkansas defeated Mississippi Valley State 92-48 on Friday night. Wilkinson shot 8 of 16 from 3-point range, tying for seventh place in school history for 3-pointers made. He made four of the five baskets in the second half as Arkansas (4-2) stretched its lead from 16 points to 25 in the first four minutes. Richmond’s 18 points came on 7-for-9 shooting. He added three steals. The Razorbacks went on a 19-3 run midway through the first half to open a 20-point lead with 7:41 left. The Delta Devils went scoreless from 10:26 to 4:17, missing eight straight field goals and committing three turnovers as Arkansas seized control. The Razorbacks shot 17 for 32 and carried a 43-25 lead into the break. Seven of Arkansas' 17 field goals were 3-pointers and eight were dunks. The Razorbacks finished with 13 dunks and 15 3s among their 35 field goals. Razorbacks freshman guard Jordan Smith Jr., a five-star recruit, did not play because of wrist inflammation. Fellow freshman Davion Thompson, who classified up a year to play in college this season, played in place of Smith and became the youngest player in Arkansas history to start a The 17-year-old finished with 13 points and 11 assists. Caleb Cameron led Mississippi Valley State (0-5) with 16 points. Up next Mississippi Valley State: At New Mexico on Wednesday.
